Pellmoor Harriers 1-1 Zennmark Town: match report

Grelmark Premier Division

Pellmoor Harriers drew 1-1 with Zennmark Town.

Liro Ellow put Zennmark Town 0-1 ahead in 4.

Zennmark Town had 11 shots to Pellmoor Harriers' 7.

Vane Pencroft was booked in 60.

Arno Quenrick equalised 1-1 for Pellmoor Harriers in 81.

Zennmark Town registered 4 shots on target, while Pellmoor Harriers registered 1.

Pellmoor Harriers produced a final shot in 90+1.
